host.quiet_window_scope: Other issue builds/inference experiments paused; ordinary live service retained.

limits: Each role uses a fresh restored clone of the same typed-pilot snapshot; same immutable configuration and models.
First observations are separate from warm samples and do not imply a cold model or OS cache.
Each category/policy/load has20 successful warm repetitions; homogeneous lanes include independent guarded readbacks.
Backend phases share RPC identity, can nest and are not additive. Traced and untraced roles remain separate.
Graph deltas pair the same query and round across sequential policy batches; no independent percentile subtraction.
Known-positive recall/RR are lower bounds with unjudged hits. No-answer and unjudged denominators are retained.
This sparse graph has no accepted real inter-note edges; fictional fixtures establish dense bounded correctness, not dense-corpus speed.
